Pastrami on white with mayo.d: Steamed until it glistens, then piled high on soft Pullman slices with mayonnaise, iceberg lettuce and sliced tomato.
Pastrami on white with mayo.note: Yes, we make it. Max the counterman winces.

Alvy's potato knishes.d: Flaky pastry around a mash of boiled Idahos and onions fried slow in butter, egg-washed and baked golden.
Alvy's potato knishes.note: Hot from the steam table all day.

Lobster bites.d: Sweet cooked meat folded with mayonnaise, lemon, diced celery and chives, piled on rounds of buttered, toasted egg bread.

New York cheesecake.d: Cream cheese, sour cream and lemon zest on a buttery crumb crust, baked slow in a water bath and chilled overnight.
New York cheesecake.note: Baked every morning. Never leaves Manhattan.

Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.d: Lime juice and honey shaken with fresh cucumber and mint, strained over ice and topped with seltzer.
Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.note: Big in Los Angeles, we hear. We wouldn't know.
